difficulty_reason: The lemma describes the tangent space of a smooth proper curve in each genus (statement lines 6878-6889). The proof (lines 6891-6912) is complete: the derivation-identification, the degree computation killing Hom(omega, O) for g >= 2, the nowhere-vanishing versus degree-two-divisor behaviour in genus 1 and 0, and the uniformizer translation of the fixed-point condition. Every step is present with no omissions. H2: degree bookkeeping on invertible sheaves with a clean local translation at the end.
